$comment: TIER 3 — MCP servers for this project. Part of the swap set (agent.config.json + CLAUDE.md + rules/guards.rules + .mcp.json); another project ships its own. Two independent Replit deployments, each with its OWN url + bearer token via env — nothing hardcoded. (a) assist-memory = mcp-assist-memory, the project-agnostic memory/coordination server (Postgres+pgvector); the hook path (lib/server_sync.py) talks to it over raw HTTP and does NOT depend on this file — this entry just registers the same server as tools for the in-session orchestrator. (b) sdk-tools = canvas-sdk-tools, a static/offline Canvas validator (no PHI, no live Canvas access); the audit agents call its tools by name. A live Canvas-instance MCP, if one exists, would be a third entry — add it here with its own CANVAS_MCP_URL/CANVAS_MCP_TOKEN.
